style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: ⟦0⟧ can perform various ⟦1⟧ on the map. The strength and impact of a mission generally depends on the size and strength of a network (more on those below).

Counter intelligence is the default mission of an agent who is not doing anything else. This boosts the Counter Intelligence value for whichever nation in which the agent is stationed, which helps catch enemy spies, reduce the effectiveness of enemy spy activity, and increase the time requirements of enemy ⟦0⟧.

Additional operatives on this mission in the same country after the first will have their efficiency progressively multiplied by ⟦0⟧ for each operative already performing the mission in the same country.
Operatives with the ⟦0⟧ trait are more effective on these missions. Agents of an intelligence agency with the ⟦1⟧ agency upgrade will be more likely to catch enemy operatives while on this mission.

Build network is a mission where the Operative will build a network of contacts in an area. Several operatives can help each other out, either to expand the reach of the network or to build it faster. Networks have various passive effects:
Countering enemy dig in or planning bonus
Faster division planning when entering a network (based on the first enemy state on the path)
Improve intel advantage in combat locally (25%) (based on the intel ledger’s intel rework)
Gives static intel on the nation based on nation level strength. You will only get naval intel if the network encompasses ports.
Networks target cities (VPs of particular size) and spread over an area. They can link up multiple operative's networks into larger ones.

The base amount of strength that an operative adds to an intel network is ⟦0⟧ per day. An intel network must have a strength of at least 10⟦1⟧ in a given state for its modifiers to start applying in that state. The maximum strength of a network depends on the host country's counter intelligence as well as the number of agents building a network. More agents building a network will increase its maximum value, while higher counter intelligence in the host country, including from ⟦2⟧ agency upgrades, will decrease it.

Networks are very important to both your missions and ⟦0⟧. All ⟦1⟧ require you to have a network of varying strength in the target country. Note that while most ⟦2⟧ only require a certain amount of strength in one part of the target country, mission efficiency is affected by the network's coverage of the entire country. This means that you will have to devote several agents if you wish to perform missions in large countries.
Operatives with a ⟦0⟧ that matches the target country are more effective on these missions in the given country.

Quiet network allows an existing intel network to be put in quiet mode. It will no longer give most of its passive effects, but covers a larger area and has only a tiny risk that any of your operatives are caught, while still maintaining the network. Quieted networks still provide their static intel benefits and still allow ⟦0⟧ to be performed in the country.

The mission is perfect if you have prepared a large network for a future invasion, for example using a quiet network to build up the network to use it for a coordinated strike later on, without the higher potential chance that your operatives are captured in a standard build network mission. It is also ideal if you have a limited number of operatives available and wish to perform multiple operations against a country without having to keep rebuilding a network each time, as one operative can quiet the network while the remaining operatives can proceed to perform repeated operations, e.g., preparing collaboration governments, against the target.
Quiet network is the only task operatives can perform that does not earn them ⟦0⟧.

Boost ideology boosts the ⟦0⟧ of the spying country's ⟦1⟧ in a target nation. This can also be used in friendly countries that share the same ideology as well, not just in countries with different governing ideologies.

The efficacy of this mission depends on how widely the intel network being used to boost ideology covers the target country, as well as the target country's counter intelligence, including from ⟦0⟧ agency upgrades. The base amount of ideology drift an operative can cause is ⟦1⟧ per day, and the maximum amount of ideology drift that an operative can instill is ⟦2⟧ per day.
Operatives with the ⟦0⟧ trait are more effective on these missions. Agents of an intelligence agency with the ⟦1⟧ agency upgrade will also be more effective on these missions.

Propaganda is used to reduce a target nation's ⟦0⟧ and War support. The effectiveness of this mission depends on the strength of the intel network being used, as well as the target country's counter intelligence, including from ⟦1⟧ agency upgrades. The base amount of damage to ⟦2⟧ and War support that an operative can cause is ⟦3⟧ per day.
You can reduce ⟦0⟧ by up to ⟦1⟧ and War support by up to ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧

Additional operatives on this mission in the same country after the first will have their efficiency progressively multiplied by ⟦0⟧ for each operative already performing the mission in the same country. Unlike other mission types, if multiple agents are performing this mission in different countries, they also receive diminished effectiveness, with their efficiency progressively multiplied by ⟦1⟧ for each country that is being targeted with this mission beyond the first.
Agents of an intelligence agency with the ⟦0⟧ agency upgrade will also be more effective on these missions.
Root out resistance lowers the ⟦0⟧ in the highlighted states. The state targeted by the operative will have its ⟦1⟧ altered by ⟦2⟧ by default, while neighboring states will receive ⟦3⟧ the effect.
Additional operatives on this mission in the same state after the first will have their efficiency progressively multiplied by ⟦0⟧ for each operative already performing the mission in the same state.

It is important to note that this mission does not decrease ⟦0⟧, only the ⟦1⟧ of the targeted states. This means that it is not necessarily suitable for dealing with resistance generated by events if those events also did not also increase resistance targets.
Agents of an intelligence agency with the ⟦0⟧ agency upgrades will also be more effective on these missions.

Control trade increases the ⟦0⟧ of the agents' country of employment in the targeted country. As trade routes are prioritized by who has the highest ⟦1⟧ in the exporting country, this can allow countries to cheat their way higher up the priority list. The maximum amount of ⟦2⟧ that can be gained in this way is ⟦3⟧.⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ gained from this mission decays at a rate of ⟦6⟧ per day when no operatives are assigned to maintain it.

Diplomatic pressure applies diplomatic pressure to the target country, increasing the willingness of its AI to accept diplomatic offers and reducing the requirements for diplomatic requests like having them join your faction. The maximum amount of AI willingness that can be added through this mission is ⟦0⟧,⟦1⟧ while the maximum amount that requirements can be lowered is ⟦2⟧.⟦3⟧
